name: Lying Leg Raise
summary: A floor exercise for the lower abs and hip flexors that needs only a mat.
setup: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides, or hands under your hips.
Press your lower back toward the floor.
execution: Raise your legs together until they point up toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without letting the lower back arch.
Stop just above the floor and repeat.
Bend the knees slightly to make it easier.
mistakes: Arching the lower back: bend the knees or lower less.
Swinging the legs: use a slow tempo.
Holding the breath: exhale as you lift.
Neck tension: keep the head relaxed on the floor.
